feedback_summary: The candidate demonstrated a basic ability to read the chart and list the data points in the correct order of magnitude. However, the response is severely undermined by a lack of linguistic precision (numerous spelling and grammatical errors) and a failure to adhere to the structural constraints of a graph description by adding personal opinions. Although a hard cap of 6 was triggered due to the inclusion of external opinions, the raw score was already below this threshold due to the poor quality of language and structure.
